source: Derived from EN product meanings; SK for product sense only. Not human-approved. International Dutch (NL); Flemish variants noted as open.

addressStyle.rationale: Matches social-app tone used in SK/DE/CS. PROPOSED — not product-approved. Flemish/NL-BE may prefer u in some contexts.

regionalNote.note: Single locale code `nl`. Do not introduce nl-NL/nl-BE without product decision. Prefer Netherlands Dutch vocabulary; note Flemish alternatives in review.

terms.notes: User content unit — not the same as Contribution.
Act of help — distinct from Bericht (Post).
Avoid charity-only Donatie for token top-ups where context is wallet.

pluralization.note: Dutch CLDR: one (n===1), other (everything else including 0 and decimals). EN pipe count is preserved (2-form: « {n} dag geleden | {n} dagen geleden », 3-form feed.resultsCount: zero|one|other). No custom pluralRules registered in boot/i18n.ts; default vue-i18n rule verified at runtime against Intl.PluralRules('nl') for n=0,1,2,5,21.
